spans.s:
ईदृक्ष ईदृक्ष, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. इद्, neut. of pro-
nom. base 3. इ, and दृक्ष, rt. दृश्, dropping one
द् and lengthening the preceding इ, as in तादृक्ष
from तद्, &c.), of this aspect, of such a kind,
endowed with such qualities, such like.

ई-दृश्, क्, Ved. ङ्, endowed with such qualities,
such; (क्), n., Ved. such a condition, such occasion.
—ईदृक्-ता, f. quality.

ईदृश, अस्, ई, अम्, or ईदृशक, अस्, इका, अम्,
endowed with such qualities, such; [with the final
syllables दृश् and दृश of these words cf. the Gr.
λικ in δμῆλιξ, λικο in τηλίκο-ς, &c.; Goth. leika
in hvêleiks, ‘welcher,’ svaleik-s, ‘such;’ Mod.
Germ. solcher; Slav. liko, nom. lik, e. g. tolik,
‘such;’ Lat. li in tâlis, quâlis.]
